name: januaport-admin
description: Administer a JanuaPort installation from Claude Desktop over its admin MCP, in the local network only.
long_description: A thin bridge from stdio to the admin MCP of a JanuaPort installation (<address>/admin/mcp, Streamable HTTP) with a bearer admin token. TLS verification is always on; an internal root CA can be added as a file. The tool list comes from the gateway itself.

address.title: Address of the installation
address.description: Base address in the local network, https only, without a path, e.g. https://box.local. The bridge appends /admin/mcp itself.

admin_token.title: Admin token
admin_token.description: A dedicated admin token for this installation with an expiry date: jnpt admin-token create --label claude-desktop-<name> --expires 720h

ca_certificate.title: Root CA of the installation (PEM)
ca_certificate.description: Only needed if the installation uses an internal CA, e.g. Caddy with tls internal. Leave empty for a publicly trusted certificate.
